midi.heading: Settings
midi.parsing_tooltip:
- Rice Cake
    The most efficient loading and displaying algorithm.
    Notes are stored in GPU-resident binary trees and displayed
    dynamically with zero CPU tree duplication.
    (Polyphony statistics are not available in this mode.)
- Standard (RAM)
    The MIDI is loaded into flat SoA RAM buffers and all notes
    are rendered directly by the GPU.
- Standard (Live Stream)
    The MIDI is streamed live from disk through bounded A/B
    window buffers for constant RAM usage on massive MIDIs.

skin.heading: Homage Skin Presets
skin.subtitle: Choose a procedural note & keyboard style. Changes apply immediately in real-time and offline renders.
skin.homage_note: All shaders and visual styles are 100% originally authored for Wanith as tributes to the classic Black MIDI players. No proprietary third-party assets are included.
skin.preset.wasaby.desc: Classic cosine-shaded falling notes with crisp dark outlines and beveled 3D keys.
skin.preset.wynthesia.desc: Rounded glossy note capsules with soft side sheen and warm classic keyboard lighting.
skin.preset.wfaplus.desc: Sharp 3D-beveled rectangular notes with crisp edges and clean high-contrast keybed.
skin.preset.zanith.desc: Sleek luminous modern notes with subtle bottom glow, specular rim, and deep dark contrast.
